title: Elevation Certificate Re-Rating on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
**Optional certificate.** Under Risk Rating 2.0 an Elevation Certificate is optional for the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own); the rating engine otherwise uses its own estimated first floor height.

**Acceptable certificate.** A certificate is accepted only on FEMA Form 086-0-33, completed and sealed by a licensed land surveyor, engineer or architect, for the building as it currently stands.

**Re-rating.** Because a certified first floor height is used on these tiers, the first floor height certified on an accepted certificate is submitted to the rating engine and the engine returns the full-term risk premium and ICC premium with that height.

**When it is applied.** The certificate is applied only when the re-rated full-term risk premium plus ICC premium is lower than the rated figures on the policy; otherwise it is kept on file, not applied, and the rating is not changed. A certificate is applied only on a policy whose status is pending effective or in force, as the policy record shows.

**Effect.** An applied certificate takes effect on the date it is received, and the reduction is credited as re-rate components:
- the risk premium credit is the fall in the full-term risk premium, multiplied by the days from the receipt date to the term end divided by the days from the term start to the term end, rounded to the cent;
- the ICC premium credit is the fall in the full-term ICC premium, prorated the same way and rounded to the cent;
- the Reserve Fund Assessment credit is the tier's Reserve Fund Assessment percentage of those two pro rata credits, rounded to the cent.

The HFIAA surcharge and the Federal Policy Fee are not affected. The credit is refunded to the payor of record. From the next renewal the re-rated premium is the prior-term figure the annual cap is measured from.

## Applied or kept on file (hypothetical figures)

| Rated risk plus ICC on the policy | Re-rated risk plus ICC | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 5,100.00 | 4,300.00 | lower — applied and credited |
| 5,100.00 | 5,100.00 | not lower — kept on file, rating unchanged |
| 5,100.00 | 5,600.00 | higher — kept on file, rating unchanged |

**Worked credit.** A 365-day term, certificate received with 73 days left, risk premium falling by 800.00 and ICC premium by 10.00, Reserve Fund Assessment percentage 18: risk credit 160.00, ICC credit 2.00, Reserve Fund Assessment credit 29.16.
